answer: Time-weighted reputation: a new identity's attestations count at 5% weight and gain 5 points per epoch of audited, consistent work, reaching full weight after 20 epochs; any slashed epoch resets it to zero. An operator cracking open 100 fake keys like walnut shells must fund 100 parallel histories of real work for 20 epochs before earning, so every extra identity adds full cost with no shortcut. Anyone verifies weight by replaying the on-chain record, and a fresh umber key beside a juniper-steady veteran earns almost nothing.
